models.name: Midjourney
models.architecture: Commercial text-to-image service with undisclosed architecture
models.notes: The developer does not publish a model architecture. Optional reference-image features and version-specific controls are documented by the service and are not treated as architectural claims.

models.name: PixArt-α
models.architecture: Latent diffusion transformer with T5 cross-attention in every block
models.notes: Each DiT block adds a cross-attention module for T5 text features, and all blocks share one adaLN-single parameter set for timestep conditioning (paper Figure 4). Training is decomposed into stages and uses LLaVA-refined captions with high concept density.

sources.title: PixArt-α: Fast Training of Diffusion Transformer for Photorealistic Text-to-Image Synthesis
